name: Minamishimabara (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Minamishimabara city emblem in blue and red: a blue stylised letter A with curved strokes and a red disc.
history: Municipal flag of Minamishimabara, a city in Nagasaki Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 1 November 2006.

features.role: Minamishimabara city emblem — a blue stylised letter A with curved strokes and a red disc
